correctness.rationale: All 462 faces, all 1295 Hasse incidences, and all 222 Morse pairs exhaustively enumerated. Directed Hasse acyclicity is fully certified by a topological sort; exactly 1 critical edge and 17 critical triangles remain. Integral signed Morse cancellation gives zero 1×17 boundary. Independent rational ranks 24 and 115 force the same zero attaching row. A CW complex with a single 1-cell and 17 trivially attached 2-cells is S^1 wedged with seventeen 2-spheres.
